title: CatalogItem
description: Canonical catalog item entity v1 (SIE-25). Full catalog-service record for a product: current price, on-hand stock, and identity. The product schema (SIE-24) is a narrower, extraction-only shape (name/unit/price) produced by voice/image-to-product; a successful extraction job creates or updates one of these.

unit.description: Free-form unit of measure, same convention as the order schema's item.unit.

price.description: Current unit price in VND. v1 only ever populates whole VND (no subunit), same convention as order-schema.v1.json's money fields. Changing it appends an entry to this item's price history.

stockOnHand.description: On-hand count (ADR 0005). Read-only via the API: it only changes through the order-confirmed event (a confirmed purchase order adds, a confirmed sales order subtracts), never a direct write.
